mapper.select: SELECT d.DEPT_CD AS deptCd, d.UPPER_DEPT_CD AS upperDeptCd, ud.DEPT_NM AS upperDeptNm, d.DEPT_LVL AS deptLvl, d.DEPT_ORDR AS deptOrdr, d.DEPT_NM AS deptNm, d.DEPT_ENG_NM AS deptEngNm, d.DEPT_SHRT_NM AS deptShrtNm, d.DEPT_SE_CD AS deptSeCd, d.DEPT_MNGR_NO AS deptMngrNo, e.EMP_NM AS deptMngrNm, d.DEPT_TELNO AS deptTelno, d.DEPT_LCTN_NM AS deptLctnNm, DATE_FORMAT(d.ESTBL_YMD, '%Y-%m-%d') AS estblYmd, DATE_FORMAT(d.CLSG_YMD, '%Y-%m-%d') AS clsgYmd, d.USE_YN AS useYn, DATE_FORMAT(d.REGIST_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS registDt, DATE_FORMAT(d.UPDT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updtDt FROM hrm_dept_master d LEFT JOIN hrm_dept_master ud ON d.UPPER_DEPT_CD = ud.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN hrm_emp_master e ON d.DEPT_MNGR_NO = e.EMP_NO ORDER BY IFNULL(d.DEPT_LVL, 1), d.DEPT_ORDR

SELECT d.DEPT_CD AS deptCd, d.UPPER_DEPT_CD AS upperDeptCd, ud.DEPT_NM AS upperDeptNm, d.DEPT_LVL AS deptLvl, d.DEPT_ORDR AS deptOrdr, d.DEPT_NM AS deptNm, d.DEPT_ENG_NM AS deptEngNm, d.DEPT_SHRT_NM AS deptShrtNm, d.DEPT_SE_CD AS deptSeCd, d.DEPT_MNGR_NO AS deptMngrNo, e.EMP_NM AS deptMngrNm, d.DEPT_TELNO AS deptTelno, d.DEPT_LCTN_NM AS deptLctnNm, DATE_FORMAT(d.ESTBL_YMD, '%Y-%m-%d') AS estblYmd, DATE_FORMAT(d.CLSG_YMD, '%Y-%m-%d') AS clsgYmd, d.USE_YN AS useYn, DATE_FORMAT(d.REGIST_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS registDt, DATE_FORMAT(d.UPDT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updtDt FROM hrm_dept_master d LEFT JOIN hrm_dept_master ud ON d.UPPER_DEPT_CD = ud.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN hrm_emp_master e ON d.DEPT_MNGR_NO = e.EMP_NO WHERE d.DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hrm_dept_master WHERE DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hrm_dept_master WHERE UPPER_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hrm_emp_master WHERE DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND EMP_STTS_CD != 'RESIGNED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hrm_dept_master ( DEPT_CD, DEPT_NM, DEPT_ENG_NM, DEPT_SHRT_NM, DEPT_SE_CD, UPPER_DEPT_CD, DEPT_LVL, DEPT_ORDR, DEPT_MNGR_NO, DEPT_TELNO, DEPT_LCTN_NM, ESTBL_YMD, USE_YN ) VALUES ( #{deptCd}, #{deptNm}, #{deptEngNm}, #{deptShrtNm}, #{deptSeCd}, #{upperDeptCd}, #{deptLvl}, #{deptOrdr}, #{deptMngrNo}, #{deptTelno}, #{deptLctnNm}, #{estblYmd}, IFNULL(#{useYn}, 'Y') )
mapper.update: UPDATE hrm_dept_master SET USE_YN = 'N', CLSG_YMD = CURDATE() WHERE DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL( MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(DEPT_CD, '-', -1) AS UNSIGNED)), 0 ) FROM hrm_dept_master WHERE DEPT_CD REGEXP '^DEPT-[0-9]+$'
